terms.title: Origin
terms.text: I started learning to code at 17, because I wanted to make my own video games.

terms.title: Animation
terms.text: I studied animation to bring those game ideas to life: BSc Animation at Fergusson College, Pune, with a CGPA of 9.24.

terms.title: Engineering
terms.text: Before that, I completed a Diploma in Computer Engineering at D.Y. Patil School of Engineering (Polytechnic), Pune.

terms.title: Japanese
terms.text: I became interested in Japanese through anime and films, and have been learning it since 2018.

terms.title: Present use
terms.text: Today I work in enterprise IT at Wipro, and build apps, games and 3D web projects on the side.

terms.title: Warranty
terms.text: This software ships with curiosity included. No toolbars are bundled.

installing.title: Installing
installing.lead: Please wait while Setup installs a career.

stages.title: Service Desk Analyst
stages.text: Started on the service desk supporting global users: user accounts and Azure AD security groups, Exchange Online distribution lists and shared mailboxes, and operating system, hardware and network issues under strict SLAs.

stages.title: SME
stages.meta: Wipro Technologies, Pune · RDS SME · to Aug 2024
stages.text: Became a subject matter expert. Built Tampermonkey scripts for ServiceNow (ticket auto-refresh, priority alerts, session keep-alive) and led DSAT analysis, reporting automation and team training.

stages.title: Application Packaging Engineer
stages.meta: Wipro Technologies, Pune · Aug 2024 to present
stages.text: Manages the full packaging lifecycle (MSI, EXE) for enterprise clients with AdminStudio and InstallShield, writes PSAppDeployToolkit wrapper scripts, and runs Intune deployments through UAT and pilot phases.

stages.title: Developer projects
stages.text: Builds apps, games and 3D web projects on the side: Global Wishes, J-Station, JLPT Flashcards and The Void. They are on the next page.

installing.earlier: Earlier: Visiting Faculty (internship) at Jagganath Rathi Vocational Guidance & Training Institute, Pune, Aug to Oct 2022, teaching graphic design tools and digital media basics to high school students.

pipeline.title: Bundled automation: ServiceNow and Exchange pipeline

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: A central PowerShell script scans ServiceNow for new requests about Distribution Lists and Shared Mailboxes.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: It reads the ticket details, signs in to Exchange Online securely, and creates or modifies the list or mailbox with its memberships and permissions.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: It posts technical updates back to the ticket and closes it automatically when done, removing manual effort.

programs.title: Installed Programs
programs.lead: The following programs were installed successfully.

items.title: Global Wishes
items.text: Release a Lantern: type a wish, and a glowing lantern floats into a shared night sky in real time. A live counter on the site shows how many wishes are in the sky.

items.title: The Void
items.text: A 2.5D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic city at dusk, inspired by games like The Last Night and Replaced. I was the lead developer and wrote the game logic.

items.title: J-Station
items.text: A Japanese internet radio streaming app. Browse stations from Japan, tap to play, and keep listening with a Now Playing screen and a mini player.

items.title: JLPT Flashcards
items.text: Vocabulary flashcards for JLPT levels N5 to N1. Tap a card to reveal the meaning, hear the pronunciation, and track progress with a daily streak.

items.title: 3D art and games
items.text: 3D models made with Blender and Maya, plus games made with Unity and Godot: classics like Ping Pong and Snake, 2D platformers, a 3D first-person shooter and 3D horror games.

japanese.title: Language Pack: Japanese
japanese.lead: An optional component that has been installing since 2018.
japanese.text: I became interested in Japanese through anime and films, and have been learning it since 2018. Two of my apps came out of that: one for listening and one for vocabulary.

apps.label: JLPT Flashcards: vocabulary for N5 to N1

finish.text: Click Launch to say hello, download the resume, or release a lantern into the shared sky at Global Wishes.

objects.title: Package box
objects.text: I manage the full packaging lifecycle (MSI and EXE) for enterprise clients, using AdminStudio and InstallShield.

objects.title: Retro monitor
objects.text: I started learning to code at 17, because I wanted to make my own video games.

objects.title: Packaging
objects.text: I package MSI and EXE installers with AdminStudio and InstallShield, and write PSAppDeployToolkit wrapper scripts for install logic and user notifications.

objects.title: Deployment
objects.text: I configure and manage deployments through Intune, including UAT, pilot phases and troubleshooting failures.

objects.title: Automation
objects.text: I built Tampermonkey scripts for ServiceNow (ticket auto-refresh, priority alerts, session keep-alive) and a PowerShell pipeline that handles Exchange Online requests end to end.

objects.title: Development
objects.text: Flutter and Dart for Android apps, React, Node.js, MongoDB and Three.js for the web, plus Python, Java and JavaScript.

objects.title: Games and 3D
objects.text: Games made with Godot (GDScript) and Unity, and 3D models made with Blender and Maya.

objects.title: Language
objects.text: Japanese: JLPT N4 certified, N3 in progress. Also English (professional), Hindi and Marathi (native).

objects.title: Automation pipeline
objects.text: A central PowerShell script scans ServiceNow for Distribution List and Shared Mailbox requests, makes the change in Exchange Online, posts updates to the ticket and closes it.
